body.summary: Animated series set in the divided city of Piltover and its undercity, Zaun. Two sisters, Vi and Powder, are orphaned by a failed uprising and taken in by the rebel Vander. Years later a heist on a Piltover apartment goes wrong, and the resulting explosion pushes the two cities toward war. Vi is imprisoned, Powder is taken in by the crime lord Silco and remade as Jinx, and the scientist Jayce and his partner Viktor develop hextech, magic harnessed through crystals. The season ends with a missile fired from the undercity into the Piltover council chamber. ||Jinx kills Silco and fires the rocket at the council while Vi watches.||

arcs.summary: A heist by Vi, Powder and friends explodes in a Piltover apartment, setting off the conflict between the cities.
Vi is jailed and later freed by Caitlyn; the two investigate the undercity and grow close.
Powder is taken in by Silco and becomes Jinx, torn between her old family and her new father.
Jayce and Viktor develop hextech from a crystal and a stolen notebook, then clash over its use as a weapon.
The council votes on peace with Zaun; Jinx's rocket interrupts the vote.

notable_scenes.summary: The heist explosion in the Piltover apartment kills friends and sets the plot in motion.
Vander fights Silco's men and is taken; the sisters are separated.
Vi and Caitlyn visit a brothel and later a shimmer den in the undercity.
Jinx lights a flare on a rooftop to signal Vi.
Jinx stages a dinner with Vi, Caitlyn and Silco and forces Vi to choose.
Jinx fires the rocket into the council chamber as the vote is held.
